title: כושר — three ways to build the page
question: The world is already decided: soft white, one material, light only where it means something. What is open is the STRUCTURE of the כושר page — the same eight doors and the same goal, arranged three different ways. Lock one, or re-roll.

options.label: המדף · The Shelf
options.thesis: The first screen is two things and nothing else — the slab that starts a workout, and the week. The other seven doors wait on one pressed shelf.
options.viewport: A raised slab across the top third: אימון חדש, and along its lower edge, in light, האחרון: לפני 3 ימים · דחיפה. Under it the week as seven pressed notches, the days you trained lit, today's notch amber. At the foot one pressed bar, עוד בכושר, that raises the seven doors out of the trough when pulled.
options.risk: Everything but starting a workout is one gesture further away than it is today, and the person who opened כושר for the stopwatch pays that gesture every time.

options.label: הערוץ · The Channel
options.thesis: The week is a tube. The nutrition screen's pressed channel with light inside, turned on its side and filled by sessions instead of calories — so כושר reads as the same instrument as תזונה.
options.viewport: One horizontal pressed channel across the top, filled with terra light to how much of the week is done, the fill glowing brightest at its leading edge. The workout slab beneath it. Then the eight doors as a two-column grid of chips raised out of a single trough, each carrying its icon in its own hue.
options.risk: It makes a weekly target the headline, and the app does not insist on one yet — somebody who trains four times a week but planned nothing sees an empty channel.

options.label: החוגה · The Dial
options.thesis: The whole page is one object. A convex disc with the workout on its face and the areas pressed into its rim, so כושר feels like a smaller room inside the one the home screen already is.
options.viewport: A 260px raised disc centred in the screen, אימון חדש on its face with the last session under it. Eight notches pressed into the rim, each holding a small raised icon disc; the notch under the thumb names itself in full beneath the disc. The goal sits below as one pressed pill.
options.risk: Eight names cannot all sit on a rim, so the rim carries icons — and an icon-only door has already failed once here: לא כולם מבינים פשוט איירונים.
